match_query: type = aws_instance and service_class = instance and purchase_option = on_demand and os = linux

description: Default number of AWS S3 Bucket PUT, POST, UPDATE, and LIST operations (Tier 1) (Per 1,000)
match_query: type = aws_s3_bucket and tier = 1 and purchase_option = on_demand

description: Default number of AWS S3 Bucket GET and other operations (Tier 2) (Per 10,000)
match_query: type = aws_s3_bucket and tier = 2 and purchase_option = on_demand

description: Default AWS S3 Bucket storage (Per GB-Month)
match_query: type = aws_s3_bucket and service_class = storage and purchase_option = on_demand and storage_class = general_purpose
type = aws_db_instance and service_class = storage and purchase_option = on_demand

description: Default AWS RDS IOPS (Per 1 million I/O requests)
match_query: type = aws_db_instance and service_class = iops and values.storage_type = standard
type = aws_db_instance and service_class = instance and purchase_option = on_demand
type = aws_sqs_queue and service_class = requests
type = aws_lambda_function and service_class = requests

description: Default AWS Lambda monthly duration, ARM (seconds)
match_query: type = aws_lambda_function and service_class = duration and values.architectures=arm64 and arch=arm64

description: Default AWS Lambda monthly duration, x86 (seconds)
match_query: type = aws_lambda_function and service_class = duration and (not values.architectures or values.architectures=x86) and arch=x86
type = aws_ebs_volume and values.type = standard and service_class = iops
type = aws_ebs_volume and service_class = storage
type = aws_dynamodb_table and service_class = storage

type = aws_dynamodb_table and service_class = storage and ((table_class = ia and values.table_class = STANDARD_INFREQUENT_ACCESS) or ((not values.table_class or values.table_class = STANDARD or values.table_class = null) and table_class = standard))

type = aws_dynamodb_table and service_class = requests and request_type = read and ((table_class = ia and values.table_class = STANDARD_INFREQUENT_ACCESS) or ((not values.table_class or values.table_class = STANDARD or values.table_class = null) and table_class = standard))

type = aws_dynamodb_table and service_class = requests and request_type = write and ((table_class = ia and values.table_class = STANDARD_INFREQUENT_ACCESS) or ((not values.table_class or values.table_class = STANDARD or values.table_class = null) and table_class = standard))
type = aws_dynamodb_table and service_class = requests and request_type = stream

description: Default AWS ACM Certificate (1 certificate issuance per resource)
match_query: type = aws_acm_certificate and service_class = certificate

description: Default AWS ECS Fargate memory (730 hours per month, multiplied by task definition memory in GB and desired_count)
match_query: type = aws_ecs_service and service_class = memory

description: Default AWS ECS Fargate vCPU (730 hours per month, multiplied by task definition vCPU count and desired_count)
match_query: type = aws_ecs_service and service_class = vcpu

description: Default AWS Grafana Workspace editor licenses (1 editor by default)
match_query: type = aws_grafana_workspace and service_class = editor

description: Default AWS Grafana Workspace viewer licenses (usage-based, 0 by default)
match_query: type = aws_grafana_workspace and service_class = viewer
